chapters.1: Paul writes a personal letter to Philemon on behalf of Onesimus, a runaway slave who became a believer and useful helper to Paul while Paul was imprisoned. Rather than commanding Philemon, Paul appeals to him out of love, asking him to welcome Onesimus back not as a slave but as a dear brother in Christ, even offering to personally repay any debt Onesimus owes, and expressing confidence that Philemon will do even more than asked.
